[P2] Keep a bounded clock hold for detached runners

An abandoned invoke can still satisfy a callback that its caller awaits outside the completed parallel. For example, the child resumes after a one-hour wait, then starts a callback-sending step involving short real I/O alongside a longer durable wait. Processing that longer wait calls `advance()`. Removing the child from `participants` lets the clock jump to the caller's competing two-hour deadline while the callback step runs, so the timeout incorrectly wins. The added callback test has no competing deadline and misses this regression. Retain a bounded hold for busy detached runners, expiring it for never-settling work, and add a callback-versus-deadline integration regression.
